_howto: Every piece of art the arena renderer has a place for. `assets` lists the registry ids that fill the slot; a slot with no assets yet is reported as missing. Add ids here when a new batch arrives.

slots.label: Corner boards (four)
slots.unfit: The corner art curves over 37x21 px; the rink's corners curve over 112 px (28 ft), which is 112x83 on screen. Shown only in the corner fit test arena.

slots.label: Kickplates (separate layers)
slots.note: Same pixels as the kickplates inside the board modules; registered, not drawn separately.

slots.label: North goal net
slots.unfit: Larger than the gameplay net: 37 px between the posts against a 24 px mouth, and about 25 px deep against 11 px. Ruling (Decision 34): the art is redrawn to the gameplay size; the net does not change. Spec in ART_BRIEF.md section 10. Shown only in the goal fit test arena.

slots.label: South goal net
slots.unfit: Larger than the gameplay net: 37 px between the posts against a 24 px mouth, and about 25 px deep against 11 px. Ruling (Decision 34): the art is redrawn to the gameplay size; the net does not change. Spec in ART_BRIEF.md section 10. Shown only in the goal fit test arena.

slots.label: Goal with puck in the net (north, south)
slots.note: Drawn at the old goal size; needs redrawing with the goals (ART_BRIEF.md section 10). Lab test in the goal fit test arena only.

slots.label: Net ripple on a goal (north, south)
slots.note: Drawn at the old goal size; needs redrawing with the goals (ART_BRIEF.md section 10). Lab test in the goal fit test arena only.

slots.label: Bottle knocked off the net (north, south)
slots.note: Drawn at the old goal size; needs redrawing with the goals (ART_BRIEF.md section 10). Lab test in the goal fit test arena only.

slots.label: Goal knocked off its moorings (north, south)
slots.note: Drawn at the old goal size; needs redrawing with the goals (ART_BRIEF.md section 10). Lab test in the goal fit test arena only.

slots.label: Player benches (home west, away east)
slots.note: Placed as a proposal: the package calls placement, anchors and spacing provisional. See ARENA.md A16.

slots.label: Penalty boxes
slots.note: Placed as a proposal: the package calls placement, anchors and spacing provisional. See ARENA.md A16.

slots.label: Timekeeper booth
slots.note: East booth placed beside the east penalty box; the west variant is not used. Placed as a proposal: the package calls placement, anchors and spacing provisional. See ARENA.md A16.

slots.label: Bench players, seated and standing
slots.note: Shown seated on both benches in placeholder blue and red. Team colours are not approved: see ARENA.md A17.

slots.label: Bench celebrations and disappointment
slots.note: Lab test only: there are no teams yet to cheer for.

slots.label: Animated bench and penalty-box doors
slots.note: Closed in play, replacing the static 10.12 gates at the same anchor. Opening is a Lab test only.

slots.label: Bench equipment (sticks, bottles, towels, bags)
slots.note: Registered, not placed: the package gives no positions. See ARENA.md A18.

slots.label: Side seating and stairs
slots.note: West and east sides. Three of the four drawn tiers show, which is the approved look (Decision 34): no sideways camera scroll. No seating exists for the ends or corners.

slots.label: Spectators, seated and standing
slots.note: Seated at seeded seats, 55% house as a proposal. See ARENA.md A20.

slots.label: Crowd reactions: cheer, goal celebration, glass banging, drinking, heckling
slots.note: In play: an occasional sip, and the goal celebration when the sim reports a goal. The rest are Lab tests.

slots.label: Goal lamps
slots.note: Goal lamp behind each net, squeezed against the edge of the world: there is no room beyond the end glass. Beacon and siren fixtures are not placed. See ARENA.md A21.

slots.label: Protective railings
slots.note: Registered, not placed: the front row sits directly against the glass, so a railing would cover it. See ARENA.md A22.

slots.label: Tunnels, aisles and departing spectators
slots.note: Registered, not placed: leaving the building needs routes and a reason to leave, neither of which is designed. See ARENA.md A22.

slots.label: Fans holding signs
slots.note: Registered, not placed. One sign reads USA, a real place, which the all-fictional rule does not allow. See ARENA.md A23.

slots.label: Columns and beams
slots.note: Registered, not placed: the package gives no positions. See ARENA.md A22.

slots.label: Ice resurfacer and trail
slots.note: Lab test only: it drives lanes and cleans the ice wear. No intermissions exist to send it out in play. See ARENA.md A24.

slots.label: Resurfacer garage
slots.unfit: The garage is 96 px deep; there are 55 px between the side boards and the edge of the world. The resurfacer is 28 px wide and the supplied doors open 24 px, so it also has no gate it can pass through. Not placed.

slots.label: Championship banners
slots.note: Registered, not placed: banners come from dynasty records, which do not exist yet, and there are no rafters to hang them from. See ARENA.md A25.

slots.label: Retired jerseys
slots.note: Registered, not placed: same reasons as the banners. See ARENA.md A25.

slots.label: Arena signage
slots.note: Registered, not placed: there are no walls outside the ice to mount signs on. See ARENA.md A25.

slots.label: Arena scoreboard, four states
slots.note: Lab test only, with sample numbers: there is no match clock or period yet, and nowhere outside the ice to mount a 128x64 board. See ARENA.md A26.

slots.label: Light fixtures and light pools
slots.note: Light pools are a Lab test. Fixtures are not placed: they mount on beams, and no beams are placed. See ARENA.md A27.

slots.label: Rink debris
slots.note: Lab test only: sticks do not break yet. See ARENA.md A24.

slots.label: Locker room floor, walls and doorway
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized. No south-east wall corner is supplied; the south-west corner is mirrored.

slots.label: Player lockers (blue, red, green, neutral; closed, open, jersey)
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized.

slots.label: Benches and loose equipment
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized.

slots.label: Players dressing, drinking, celebrating and frustrated
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized. Blue and red are baked colour variants, not the created player's appearance.

slots.label: Coach and captain
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized. The design has captains and managers but no coach: see ARENA.md A28.

slots.label: Tactics whiteboard
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized.

slots.label: Trophy cabinet and awards
slots.note: Locker room fit test only (Arena Asset Lab). The locker room is not a location in the game yet: lifestyle systems are not authorized. Shown empty; the sample trophies are a labelled test. A real cabinet is filled from career history only.
